instruction: Disable the background cone display in VLC.

command: import pyautogui; import time; pyautogui.click({SCREEN_WIDTH_HALF}, {SCREEN_HEIGHT_HALF}); time.sleep(0.5);

metadata.trajectory_summary: Agent opened VLC, navigated Tools > Preferences > Advanced (All) > Interface > Main interfaces > Qt, set 'Maximum Volume displayed' to 200, and saved. Task completed successfully.
metadata.capability_extraction: Can open VLC menus, navigate Advanced Preferences tree, find Qt interface settings, modify numeric values, and save preferences.
metadata.task_rationale: Same navigation pattern (Advanced Preferences > Qt interface) but targets a different setting (background cone toggle instead of volume). Tests the model's ability to find and modify a checkbox setting in the same preferences section.
metadata.explanation: Task requires navigating to VLC Advanced Preferences > Qt interface and unchecking 'Display background cone or art'. Evaluator reads vlcrc config file and checks qt-bgcone equals 0 (disabled). Default is 1 (enabled).

llm_judge_reasons: Getter (vlc_config) correctly reads the vlcrc configuration file from the VM, which contains the qt-bgcone setting.
Metric (check_qt_bgcone) correctly parses vlcrc for 'qt-bgcone=' line and compares against expected value of 0 (disabled). Default value of 1 (enabled) is correctly handled.
Expected value handling is correct: get_rule returns {'expected_qt_bgcone': 0}, and the metric accesses rule['expected_qt_bgcone'] directly — no incorrect nested access patterns.
Postconfig correctly kills VLC (forcing config write to disk) then relaunches, ensuring vlcrc reflects the saved preference state.
Complete coverage: the single instruction requirement (disable background cone) is fully verified by the single evaluator check.
